## Research Team

![](assets/team/parks_research_team_image.png){fig-align="center" width="100%" alt="Safer Parks Dashboard research team"}

- Dr Anna Barker
  - Internationally recognised expert in women’s safety in public spaces and parks.
  - [Associate Professor in Criminal Justice & Criminology](https://essl.leeds.ac.uk/law/staff/177/dr-anna-barker)

- Dr Fran Pontin
  - Urban data scientist specialising in open data, dashboards, and spatial inequalities
  - [Lecturer & Senior Research Fellow](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/geography/staff/8970/dr-fran-pontin)

- Dr Maeve Murphy Quinlan
  - Research software engineer leading open-source dashboard and scalable tool development. 
  - [Reserach Software Engineer](https://arc.leeds.ac.uk/team/maeve-murphy-quinlan/)

- Dr Vikki Houlden
  - Urban data scientist focusing on inclusive greenspace, wellbeing, and spatial inequalities. 
  - [Associate Professor in Urban Data Science](https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/geography/staff/9618/dr-vikki-houlden)

- Dr Melissa Barrientos
  - Spatial design specialist developing gender-sensitive metrics for park safety.
  - [Research Fellow](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Melissa-Barrientos)

[Collaboration driving safer public spaces ]{.emphasis}

The Safer Parks Dashboard has been developed through close collaboration with partners, funders and supporters committed to improving safety, access and inclusion in parks, who have contributed expertise, resources and guidance throughout the project.
